notes.title: New Update! Physics based flips, New Challenges, Input Fixes and more!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Guys,[/p][p]Hope everyone is enjoying the last update! So what started as a quick hotfix, turned into another pretty good update (sorry for the delay there)

Here's a rundown of the changes:

[b]\[NEW][/b] Physics based flips. You can now flip over walls and onto objects. This has been long requested and really unlocks a ton of new gameplay opportunities. [/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Better blend out of in air flips. Momentum is better preserved for in air flips before correction kicks in![/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] More realistic landing heights. We've reduced slightly the height at which you can take drops with and without rolling. Going to be finetuning this over the next few updates, as well as adding more landing animations and audio and visual cues for landing requirements.[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] More realistic grab and wall slide heights. You can no longer grab from the top of a skyscraper lol. ow if you attempt to grab a ledge after falling too far, you'll slip out when grabbing and bail (actually looks really cool). Again, going to be tweaking these limits and also adding more grab animations depending on falling height etc.[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] New speed challenge across skyscrapers[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] New chase on city-group rooftop[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Added checkpoints in existing speed challenges[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] We're starting to work on flow and taking a better look at scoring. Now as you chain moves the movement will slowly speed up. This is still missing the HUD visuals but will be adding that in one of the next few updates![/p][p][b]\[FIX][/b] Couple crash fixes[/p][p][b]\[FIX][/b] Fixed water reset during wharf chase[/p][p][b]\[FIX][/b] Fixed some collision issues stopping double vaults and climbs etc[/p][p][b]\[FIX][/b] A few input fixes. There were some inputs blocking each other despite not having any clashes i.e., holding Triggers were blocking climbs etc. These have been fixed as well as some additional fallbacks for very basic movements to improve general flow[/p][p][b]\[FIX][/b] Fixed some input chaining bugs with the tap vaults and flips causing you to flip out of sticks or vault/flip when you didn't want to.[/p][p][b]\[FIX][/b] Fixed camera zoom in stuck on sprint[/p][p][b]\[FIX][/b] Improved turn in place for M+K. There are some issues with the slow movement, turn in place and starts in general for keyboard and controller that we're working on. Should have a fix and improvements for that soon![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for the support and let us know any feedback in the comments or [url="https://discord.com/invite/storrorparkourpro"]discord[/url]

Team SPP[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: [b][NEW][/b] Physics based flips. You can now flip over walls and onto objects. This has been long requested and really unlocks a ton of new gameplay opportunities.
[b][NEW][/b] Better blend out of in air flips. Momentum is better preserved for in air flips before correction kicks in!

[b][NEW][/b] More realistic landing heights. We've reduced slightly the height at which you can take drops with and without rolling. Going to be finetuning this over the next few updates, as well as adding more landing animations and audio and visual cues for landing requirements.

[b][NEW][/b] More realistic grab and wall slide heights. You can no longer grab from the top of a skyscraper lol. ow if you attempt to grab a ledge after falling too far, you'll slip out when grabbing and bail (actually looks really cool). Again, going to be tweaking these limits and also adding more grab animations depending on falling height etc.
[b][NEW][/b] New speed challenge across skyscrapers
[b][NEW][/b] New chase on city-group rooftop
[b][NEW][/b] Added checkpoints in existing speed challenges

[b][NEW][/b] We're starting to work on flow and taking a better look at scoring. Now as you chain moves the movement will slowly speed up. This is still missing the HUD visuals but will be adding that in one of the next few updates!

tags.bug: [b][FIX][/b] Couple crash fixes
[b][FIX][/b] Fixed water reset during wharf chase
[b][FIX][/b] Fixed some collision issues stopping double vaults and climbs etc

[b][FIX][/b] A few input fixes. There were some inputs blocking each other despite not having any clashes i.e., holding Triggers were blocking climbs etc. These have been fixed as well as some additional fallbacks for very basic movements to improve general flow
[b][FIX][/b] Fixed some input chaining bugs with the tap vaults and flips causing you to flip out of sticks or vault/flip when you didn't want to.
[b][FIX][/b] Fixed camera zoom in stuck on sprint

[b][FIX][/b] Improved turn in place for M+K. There are some issues with the slow movement, turn in place and starts in general for keyboard and controller that we're working on. Should have a fix and improvements for that soon!

notes.title: New Big Update! (Missions, Chase mode, Demolition Site and more)
notes.content:
[p]Hey Everyone![/p][p]We've released a new update to SPP that we've been hard at work on over the last few weeks! Hopefully this update gives you a sense of where we're heading and the quality bar that we're aiming for. We're excited to bring you more content and improvements very soon! [/p][p]The core aims for this update were to improve the initial onboarding experience, offer some more basic and simplified control options, present the mechanics and skill progression in a more self driven and challenge focused way, and expand upon the overall sense of adventure and fun![/p][p]Internally, we also drastically improved many core systems. A notable one is the mission/challenge system and its network replication. Challenges are now significantly easier to author and place, with the system also setup to allow for dynamic player created challenges in the near future![/p][p]We're going to be adding lots more content over the course of this week, so stay tuned and expect new challenges every day![/p][p]Let's get straight into what's new in this update:[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Our first mission (Demolition site Escape). Make your way through the demolition site, learning the fundamental mechanics of the game.[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Chase and Escape Mode. New multiplayer game mode, where one team are runners with the objective of racking up as many points as possible without getting caught. The others are chasers, trying to catch them within the time limit. This one is very fun. Many more chase spots to be added over the coming days/weeks![/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Improved attacks. Added push, smoother tackle and physics based drop kicks. [/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Demolition Site Spot[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Vauxhall walls spot[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Warmups. These are our new approach to mechanic tutorials. Accessible from the menu or discoverable in the level, learn the mechanics of the game at your own pace. Expect more to be added and existing ones improved based on your feedback over the coming weeks.[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Improved camera system. We've added a hybrid follow cam to give more simplified character control options to players. You can turn this off in settings. Let us know how this feels and any issues you guys are having. This will take some time to get just right but we require your feedback to do so![/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Improved Compass. Can now discover challenges easier, as well as see checkpoints and other players in challenges.
[b]NEW][/b] Alternate vaults and flips input. Default vaults and flips can be triggered on a tap of the vault/flip button.[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Collectibles and tagging. Find and spray signs dotted around the level. The tagging and collectable system will continue to be built out over the coming weeks![/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Missions and Challenges accessible from adventure tab in menu.[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Additional camera and HUD settings in menu.[/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] A couple new T-Shirts. Going to be drastically improving customisation as a whole very soon![/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Reworked Keyboard and Mouse controls. Some of those inputs were bound horribly lol. Hopefully current setup is much more comfortable. We're going to be taking a closer look at this based on your feedback! [/p][p][b]\[NEW][/b] Bunch of other fixes, optimisations and improvements.

As usual, there's going to be bugs, crashes and some funny (or not) glitches, but bare with us! We're a small team and really rely on your feedback and testing to improve, find and eliminate all the issues. Thank you all for the support and we'll have plenty of updates with new chases, challenges and more this week![/p][p][/p][p]Remember to[url="https://discord.gg/storrorparkourpro"] join the discord[/url]! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Team SPP[/b][/p]

tags.feature: [b][NEW][/b] Our first mission (Demolition site Escape). Make your way through the demolition site, learning the fundamental mechanics of the game.

[b][NEW][/b] Chase and Escape Mode. New multiplayer game mode, where one team are runners with the objective of racking up as many points as possible without getting caught. The others are chasers, trying to catch them within the time limit. This one is very fun. Many more chase spots to be added over the coming days/weeks!
[b][NEW][/b] Improved attacks. Added push, smoother tackle and physics based drop kicks.
[b][NEW][/b] Demolition Site Spot
[b][NEW][/b] Vauxhall walls spot

[b][NEW][/b] Warmups. These are our new approach to mechanic tutorials. Accessible from the menu or discoverable in the level, learn the mechanics of the game at your own pace. Expect more to be added and existing ones improved based on your feedback over the coming weeks.

[b][NEW][/b] Improved camera system. We've added a hybrid follow cam to give more simplified character control options to players. You can turn this off in settings. Let us know how this feels and any issues you guys are having. This will take some time to get just right but we require your feedback to do so!
[b][NEW][/b] Improved Compass. Can now discover challenges easier, as well as see checkpoints and other players in challenges.
[b]NEW][/b] Alternate vaults and flips input. Default vaults and flips can be triggered on a tap of the vault/flip button.
[b][NEW][/b] Collectibles and tagging. Find and spray signs dotted around the level. The tagging and collectable system will continue to be built out over the coming weeks!
[b][NEW][/b] Missions and Challenges accessible from adventure tab in menu.
[b][NEW][/b] Additional camera and HUD settings in menu.
[b][NEW][/b] A couple new T-Shirts. Going to be drastically improving customisation as a whole very soon!

[b][NEW][/b] Reworked Keyboard and Mouse controls. Some of those inputs were bound horribly lol. Hopefully current setup is much more comfortable. We're going to be taking a closer look at this based on your feedback!

notes.title: Game Update! 4th July

[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]New update is now live, with a bunch of additions, improvements and fixes to the world, visuals, gameplay, challenges and more! [/p][p]We're working every day on the game, and aside from working on this update and the next, we have spent a lot of time these last few months working on the vision and design for the whole game. As we've said before, this really is just the very start and we have so much more planned for SPP. We're excited to share these plans and roadmap with you in the coming weeks![/p][p]As always, thank you for your support and patience, and if you're enjoying the game/feel this update has improved the experience for you, a review on steam would be much appreciated! 

Also [url="https://discord.gg/storrorparkourpro"]Join the Discord[/url] to leave us any and all feedback/suggestions. Your feedback is super important to us, good or bad, and will help us make the best game possible.[/p][p]

This new system sets us up for implementing dynamic key rebinding/control layout schemes (Arcade, Classic etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic parkour physics - Movement and traversal now works correctly on moving objects. notes.title: Game Update 7th May
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

Beta Build is now live on default branch, Patch notes below!

As always, any bugs/issues/feedback let us know in the comments or [url=https://discord.gg/PUZ5NVbQ4k]Join the Discord[/url] to connect with us quicker, and to stay up to date on fixes and upcoming changes!

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b][NEW][/b] Added wall sliding! Hold Grab to when approaching a flat wall whilst falling to wallslide.

[b][NEW][/b] Added wall 180s! While wall sliding, point your move input behind the character in the direction you want to launch in and use jump to charge and jump away from the wall. Exciting to see how you guys make use of this mechanic.

[b][NEW][/b] Added Tic Tac Variants! Holding Just Left Trigger/Right mouse Button) and Jumping will do a one foot tic tac, and holding both triggers/ both mouse buttons will do a sort of wall 180 tic tac variant. You can now actually 180 your way up chimneys, Tim Champion style.

[b][NEW][/b] Added Kong Front Vault.[b] Hold Vault (Left Trigger) and Flick modifier (Right Bumper)[/b] and flick [b]Up [/b]on the Right Thumb Stick to Perform a Kong Front. You can do this over, off, onto (KF's onto will do a physics launched KF until we capture the correct animation for this!). Think this is my favourite vault now. There's some issues doing this with K+M that we're aware of so will let you guys know when that's fixed!

[b][NEW][/b] Added Kong Gainer. [b]Hold Vault (Left Trigger) and Flick modifier (Right Bumper) [/b]and flick [b]Down [/b]on the Right Thumb Stick to Perform a Kong Gainer. This currently only works when vaulting over something as we don't have the coverage for the other cases yet, but will add them after our next mocap session! Also some issues with this on K+M.

[b][NEW][/b] Slow motion is back! Press Right Thumb stick / Ctrl Key to trigger slow motion. We will have a slider for the slow motion speed in a coming update. Slow motion is also disabled in multiplayer.

[b][CHANGE][/b] Tic Tacs now no longer require a double tap but are instead a hold and release like the step jump. Let us know how this feels. This changed so there was less difficulty timing the power and more consistency across powered jump types. It also makes for chaining wall 180s and gauging power a lot more consistent.

[b][CHANGE][/b] Precision Mode toggle is now on a long press/hold on the [b]Left thumb stick / Shift[/b] Key. Sprint remains a quick press. Keen to get you guys feedback on this change! It allows for Slow motion on the right thumb stick and eventually camera change on long press right thumb stick, but definitely want to hear everyone's thoughts on this!

[b][OPTIMSATION][/b] Ledge detection refactor. Significantly optimised which has also reduced frame spikes in dense areas of the map.

[b][OPTIMISATION][/b] Physics and Collision optimisation. Some mesh and physics collision optimisations to give better more stable performance throughout the level.
[b]
[OPTIMISATION][/b] Host of other key optimisations in terms of level, character and game thread logic.

[b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Improved distance matching on jumps. you can now jump onto and over objects much closer (and even when colliding).

[b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Reduced over wall width threshold. Should give more stable context detection for thicker walls. 

[b][LEVEL][/b] Small changes and tweaks to the level, adjusting gaps and unusable areas.

[b][FIX] [/b] Pausing in multiplayer no longer pauses for everyone in lobby

[b][FIX] [/b]Some pose matching and attack crash fixes

[b][FIX] [/b]Collision issues when grabbing

[b][FIX][/b] Clamped sliding speed and slide jump velocity to avoid those crazy power jumps

[b][FIX] [/b]No more jittery feet when falling at higher velocities

[b][FIX][/b] Host of other bug fixes. As usual any new ones and existing ones please report in the discord 

Thanks for the support as always!
Team SPP

notes.title: New Beta Build Update - 6th May
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

New Beta Build is now live! Added some new mechanics and more vaults, as well as an overhaul on the ledge detection which is now far more optimised. This should especially eliminate those frame drops in certain areas of the level. Thank you all for reporting the crashes you're having, most seem to be GPU and DX12 crashes so we're working on solutions for them asap. 

In regards to our scheduled April updates, we've been taking a step back from adding too many new modes, features etc to focus on the game vision, features and player experience and are working on a couple things to convey that vision to you guys, including a comprehensive roadmap for the game, so you guys can see where our focus is and help guide us there too. It did mean that features like the character customisation didn't come out in time, as we decided to prioritise optimisations and core gameplay mechanics and stability over cosmetic stuff. Apologies for any disappointment there but we're grinding away to get those bits ready with the new menu for you guys!

We're also doing quite a big refactor of the input system and rewriting a lot of the code. As cumbersome as this is, it will definitely be worth it in the long run and the new system is far more manageable with less edge cases, which will allow us to easily implement key rebinding as well.

In the meantime, Hopefully this update has enough new mechanics and animations to keep you guys finding new ways to explore the world.

The beta branch won't work in multiplayer with those on the default branch (wont see any of the lobbies and vice versa), so make sure to switch to the correct branch to play with friends on one or the other!

[b]BETA PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b][NEW][/b] Added wall sliding! Hold Grab to when approaching a flat wall whilst falling to wallslide.

[b][NEW][/b] Added wall 180s! While wall sliding, point your move input behind the character in the direction you want to launch in and use jump to charge and jump away from the wall. Exciting to see how you guys make use of this mechanic.

[b][NEW][/b] Added Tic Tac Variants! Holding Just Left Trigger/Right mouse Button) and Jumping will do a one foot tic tac, and holding both triggers/ both mouse buttons will do a sort of wall 180 tic tac variant. You can now actually 180 your way up chimneys, Tim Champion style.

[b][NEW][/b] Added Kong Front Vault.[b] Hold Vault (Left Trigger) and Flick modifier (Right Bumper)[/b] and flick [b]Up [/b]on the Right Thumb Stick to Perform a Kong Front. You can do this over, off, onto (KF's onto will do a physics launched KF until we capture the correct animation for this!). Think this is my favourite vault now. There's some issues doing this with K+M that we're aware of so will let you guys know when that's fixed!

[b][NEW][/b] Added Kong Gainer. [b]Hold Vault (Left Trigger) and Flick modifier (Right Bumper) [/b]and flick [b]Down [/b]on the Right Thumb Stick to Perform a Kong Gainer. This currently only works when vaulting over something as we don't have the coverage for the other cases yet, but will add them after our next mocap session! Also some issues with this on K+M.

[b][NEW][/b] Slow motion is back! Press Right Thumb stick / Ctrl Key to trigger slow motion. We will have a slider for the slow motion speed in a coming update. Slow motion is also disabled in multiplayer.

[b][CHANGE][/b] Tic Tacs now no longer require a double tap but are instead a hold and release like the step jump. Let us know how this feels. This changed so there was less difficulty timing the power and more consistency across powered jump types. It also makes for chaining wall 180s and gauging power a lot more consistent.

[b][CHANGE][/b] Precision Mode toggle is now on a long press/hold on the [b]Left thumb stick / Shift[/b] Key. Sprint remains a quick press. Keen to get you guys feedback on this change! It allows for Slow motion on the right thumb stick and eventually camera change on long press right thumb stick, but definitely want to hear everyone's thoughts on this!

[b][OPTIMSATION][/b] Ledge detection refactor. Significantly optimised which has also reduced frame spikes in dense areas of the map.

[b][OPTIMISATION][/b] Physics and Collision optimisation. Some mesh and physics collision optimisations to give better more stable performance throughout the level.
[b]
[OPTIMISATION][/b] Host of other key optimisations in terms of level, character and game thread logic.

[b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Improved distance matching on jumps. you can now jump onto and over objects much closer (and even when colliding).

[b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] Reduced over wall width threshold. Should give more stable context detection for thicker walls. 

[b][LEVEL][/b] Small changes and tweaks to the level, adjusting gaps and unusable areas.

[b][FIX] [/b] Pausing in multiplayer no longer pauses for everyone in lobby

[b][FIX] [/b]Some pose matching and attack crash fixes

[b][FIX] [/b]Collision issues when grabbing

[b][FIX][/b] Clamped sliding speed and slide jump velocity to avoid those crazy power jumps

[b][FIX] [/b]No more jittery feet when falling at higher velocities

[b][FIX][/b] Host of other bug fixes. As usual any new ones and existing ones please report in the discord (link below)

Thanks again for the feedback and support, keep it coming!
Team SPP

notes.title: Patch Notes 23rd April - [LIVE]
notes.content:
[b]-PATCH NOTES-[/b]

[NEW] Crash reporting. If you can send the crash report when prompted, it would be much appreciated so we can get to the bottom of all the possible crashes!

[NEW] Host of new vault animations. Especially for vaulting onto, over and off objects. These new animations are far more fluid and stable, resulting in significantly smoother traversals.

[NEW] Added drop kick. Right face button on gamepad or C on K+M. I stumbled across the animation when looking through a recent mocap session and it felt rude not to add it.

[NEW] Added slide jumping. Pretty self explanatory this one, you can now charge and jump off slope slides. Can't wait to see the lines you guys pull off with this!

[NEW] Swapped thief for lazy vault (will be adding thief back soon).

[IMPROVEMENT] Much more comprehensive input device support. Correct detection for PlayStation, Xbox and M+K. As well as improved disconnect and reconnection support and a host of other input related improvements. I.e., correct device overlays, correct glyphs on UI etc.

[IMPROVEMENT] Controller and M+K swapping at runtime. Overlays and glyphs should now be correctly displayed when switching between input devices.

[IMPROVEMENT] Level optimisations. Texture, collision and other graphics optimisations. Let us know what kind of frame rate and performance changes you guys are experiencing.

[IMPROVEMENT] Gameplay optimisations. Trace, collision and a host of other character optimisations. Still a lot more to come on this front though once we've fixed some of the outstanding bugs!

[IMPROVEMENT] Improved capsule and mesh physics collisions. Less bails, more boinks and a lot less annoying. This also fixes a lot of bugs like phasing through objects and walls etc.

[IMPROVEMENT] Reduce bails. Colliding against objects and surfaces when close to the ground will no longer make you bail. Makes navigating tight spaces a lot more stable.

[IMPROVEMENT] Improved optimal ledge detection. Character will now pick the ledge closest to neck height, similar to that of dynos. this means small lips protruding from walls won't be selected over more pronounced ledges that are more climbable and within close range. This of course only affects non physics driven actions like wallpops etc. Some more improvements to the ledge detection coming soon as well.

[IMPROVEMENT] Locomotion improvements and fixes. Correct threshold for walk and run.

[IMPROVEMENT] Improved vault physics. Vaulting over, off and onto things is a lot more fluid and stable, and vaults such as lazy and dash now don't make you bail like crazy.

[IMPROVEMENT] Arm jumps and grabs are a lot more stable and result in less bails. Although still driven by your gravity trajectory, there is now a greater range for those flatter arm jumps and more animations , fallbacks and soft bails are on the way soon too!

[IMPROVEMENT] Standing jumps now triggered more reliably when having no input, stopping and idling.

[FIX] Bunch of crash cases fixed. We've also identified the cause of a few more, especially in regards to graphics profiles and configurations, which will be fixed in an upcoming update.

[FIX] Fixed frame dependencies for some of the physics behaviour like swings, pole sliding and more.

[FIX] Sound mix fixed, especially for music (Mad Place won't make your eardrums explode anymore, but it will still make your head bop tho, serious tune that one).

[FIX] No longer bail when getting up. This was an annoying one.

[FIX] Can now climb the crane. Little janky still but working on the climbing and level collision geometry. Both of these will be improved over time!

[FIX] Fixed Pole slides and slide brake on M+K.

[FIX] Fixed Ghost step bug. Especially evident on step jumps, which would sometimes get you stuck running/floating in air.

[FIX] Fixed Turn in place overriding actions.

[FIX] Fixed warping bugs on various actions.

[FIX] Fixed jump power bar being stuck on screen in different scenarios.

[FIX] Palm spins fixed and with improved syncing. A new favourite of mine this one!

[FIX] Fixed slide being triggered twice when walking onto slopes.

[FIX] Probably a bunch more, but any bugs you are still experiencing that you've reported and haven't been fixed in this update will be in one of the next ones!

[UPCOMING] New menu. We're nearly there with the new menu system. Much easier to navigate, as well as sections for character, missions, map and online, and improved control guide and more comprehensive settings!

[UPCOMING] Time trial and mission refactor nearly there too. Improved UX/UI and more stable objectives/feedback.

Team SPP

notes.title: Game Update 15th April
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

Sorry for the lack of communication this past week, it's been a hectic one! Just to keep everyone up to date, we're currently working hard on everyone's feedback and have made some key improvements that we're going to be pushing out in a new build (or two) this week, first to the beta branch before updating the main game branch. 

This next update will include:

- Performance and level optimisations

- Much more comprehensive input device support. We've rewritten a bunch of input handling code so it should improve your experience connecting, disconnecting and playing with different controllers (Still use a controller for the best experience whilst we finetune Mouse and Keyboard controls!)

- Improved arm jump/grab range (no longer just banging into the wall when trying to grab stuff if you're not spot on with your trajectory)

- Drastically reduced bailing, especially in tight areas and when close to the ground. Now bumping into small obstacles, or jumping into a wall when on the ground won't make you break all your bones anymore lol. This will eventually also be improved further when we add more soft bails, saves, and wall slides etc.

- Character collision fixes (less phasing through walls and what not)

- Bunch of other bug fixes and improvements

We're also finishing up the new menu and should hopefully get that out to you guys within the week, as well as some more gameplay settings, more granular graphics settings and other bits!

Finally, we're still working on the tutorial rework, as well as a bunch of your suggestions. There are some game design aspects that we are really nailing down on in order to ensure not only the tutorial, but entire gameplay loop are dialled in.

Thank you guys for the patience, feedback and suggestions. It really is going to help us continue to build SPP into the game we all want it to be!

notes.title: April 05 - Update Notes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Thank you all for the support this week, It's been great seeing people start to get into the game and pulling off some crazy lines. We're full focus on bug fixing and improvements, as well as some key UI and UX changes, so expect multiple updates this coming week!

Again if you could [url=https://discord.gg/NNBwAyRP2b]Join our discord[/url] to leave us any feedback and report bugs/issues so we can fix things as quickly as possible!

Here's what's changed, and what we're still looking into:

[INPUT-LAG] We're still trying to get into the bottom of what's causing the input lag for some users. This is not the expected behaviour, and is different from the action queueing in the game. 

[BUG] Frame limiter added but noticing some problems with it, we're looking into that now, should be fixed properly for next update!

[FIX] [CRASH] We've fixed some more crashes from multiplayer and tutorial functionality. If you're experiencing some more crashes drop a message in the discord to let us know when you're getting them so we can fix!

[FIX] Controller type detection. Previously the game was picking up all controllers as an Xbox controller. PlayStation controllers should now be properly detected and show the correct glyphs.

[FIX] Mouse and Keyboard flick detection. M+K controls are still very WIP and subject to change as our focus has really been on controller! Expect more M+K improvements and control tweaks this week!

[FIX] Tuck on mouse and keyboard causing reset.

[FIX] Fixed Tutorial objectives not properly being registered as completed, as well as controller hints showing the correct hint for the active objective.

[FIX] Bunch of other stuff, losing track at this point lol

[IMPROVEMENT] [TUTORIAL] Simplified tutorial. The current tutorial has had some stages removed to be more friendly for new players. We're working on a fully modular and comprehensive tutorial with multiple sections and stages (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced etc) that players can go through at their own pace. This was unfortunately was not ready for EA launch but will be added in the coming weeks.

[IMPROVEMENT] [UX] Quit from the pause menu and leave from the online menu now returns you to the main menu. Quitting from the main menu will exit the game. Now you can quit multiplayer sessions, the tutorial or replay the tutorial without restarting your game.

[IMPROVEMENT] [LOCOMOTION] Improved locomotion, especially starts. Character rotation now turns to desired input direction faster and more reliably, as well as having less jank due to not switching between walk and run smoothly.

[IMPROVEMENT] [LOCOMOTION] Turn in place on quick flicks of the Left thumb-stick work a lot better now. A turn in place can be interrupted by another one now too, which allows for more control and responsive turn in place inputs.

[IMPROVEMENT] [PARKOUR] Improved distance sync/match for jumping onto objects. Should revert less to a wallpop. 

[IMPROVEMENT] [PARKOUR] Double Kong is now also triggered when inputting another Catpass before taking off in your current, as well as on a double flick. Should make them more consistent to perform whilst we improve the double flick detection!

[IMPROVEMENT] Precision mode active feedback

[IMPROVEMENTS] Host of other tweaks and improvements to gameplay and tutorial.

[COMING-SOON] New Menu and UI changes.

[COMING-SOON] NEW TUTORIAL AND MISSION SYSTEM

[COMING-SOON] Improved parkour action animation coverage

[COMING-SOON] Bunch of other stuff! Stay tuned!

We're working on a fully modular and comprehensive tutorial with multiple sections and stages (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced etc) that players can go through at their own pace. This was unfortunately was not ready for EA launch but will be added in the coming weeks.

[IMPROVEMENT] [UX] Quit from the pause menu and leave from the online menu now returns you to the main menu. Quitting from the main menu will exit the game. Now you can quit multiplayer sessions, the tutorial or replay the tutorial without restarting your game.

[IMPROVEMENT] [LOCOMOTION] Improved locomotion, especially starts. Character rotation now turns to desired input direction faster and more reliably, as well as having less jank due to not switching between walk and run smoothly.

[IMPROVEMENT] [LOCOMOTION] Turn in place on quick flicks of the Left thumb-stick work a lot better now. A turn in place can be interrupted by another one now too, which allows for more control and responsive turn in place inputs.
[IMPROVEMENT] [PARKOUR] Improved distance sync/match for jumping onto objects. Should revert less to a wallpop.

[IMPROVEMENT] [PARKOUR] Double Kong is now also triggered when inputting another Catpass before taking off in your current, as well as on a double flick. Should make them more consistent to perform whilst we improve the double flick detection!
[IMPROVEMENT] Precision mode active feedback
[IMPROVEMENTS] Host of other tweaks and improvements to gameplay and tutorial.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

First off, we just want to say a massive thank you to everyone who has jumped into Early Access and supported us so far! Your feedback has been essential, and we truly appreciate you being part of this journey with us. 

We are aware that some of you have run into issues, having identified several key problems affecting playability and are working hard to get them fixed. A patched version is already live, and we’ll keep rolling out updates until everything runs smoothly. 

It would help us tremendously if you could [b][url=https://discord.gg/9pKaQZpMft]join our Discord server[/url][/b] to share feedback, get help, and connect with an awesome group of players and moderators who are always happy to assist! 


We’re currently working on fixing and addressing the following issues: 

[INPUT-LAG] We are having reports of some anomalies in registering inputs, it looks like in some configurations, the controller input is lagged by about 1/3 of a second. Some players are experiencing this issue while some others seem to be fine, we are going to add a separate report for this very crucial issue and try to resolve it with the help of our community, if you are impacted by the input lag bug please [url=https://discord.gg/9pKaQZpMft]join us on Discord[/url] and provide us with as much information as possible. 

[CRASH] INVESTIGATING: Multiplayer sessions hard crash on joining. We think we have got most of the crashes but will still monitoring and analysing. Please report any crashes related to joining multiplayer lobbies if they still occur. 

[CRASH] FIX: Some challenges (yellow STORROR S on the ground) were ill configured, generating an exception. 

[CRASH] FIX: Joining tutorial in multiplayer due to incorrect ownership. 

[FIX] Climbs not properly clearing action queue. 

[FIX] Fixed jump into wall and bail when close. 

[FIX] Clear power input on global action cooldown. 

[FIX] Disable quick menu in tutorial. 

[FIX] Tic-Tac not working on some walls, and on mouse and keyboard. 

[FIX] Descents for mouse and keyboard. 

[FIX] Restart tutorial from menu upon completion. 

[FIX] Slow-mo triggered, change character on tap, increased XY launch on laches. 

[FIX] Tutorial objectives not registering. 

[IMPROVEMENT] Easier to follow tutorial. 

[IMPROVEMENT] More dialed-in lache launches. 

[IMPROVEMENT] More customisable gameplay params -> Camera lag - x and y sensitivity - action queue time. 

[IMPROVEMENT] Improved multiplayer lobby searched and fixes. 

[IMPROVEMENT] Faster action triggered after landing. 

[IMPROVEMENT] [INVESTIGATING] Steam input system recognises Playstation controllers as xbox emulated controllers, showing wrong icons for face buttons. We are going to fix this by having a manual override where you can specify what controller you are using. 


[i]Thanks again for being here- we’re excited to keep improving the game with you! 🚀

notes.title: Community Update #2 - Dev Progress & BTS
notes.content:
Hiya, it’s been a while! But we’re coming to you with a few updates 🗣️   

The gears are grinding at full [i]Steam[/i] ahead toward an early access release, and there's been progress on all levels!   From major improvements on our fully functional multiplayer mode, to the finalisation of the initial missions, as well as an implemented scoring system. 
Amongst this, workflow has also included finishing off the skyscraper level, and making headway on the construction site & council estate levels, with rumours of a highly anticipated bail system underway. 

The game is also running on Steam Deck (!) and the engineers are currently working hard on optimising that experience too.   

As part of all this, we have been sharing insights into the various stages of the dev process in the form of a new docu-series over on our [b]shiny new SPP YouTube channel[/b] ([url=https://www.youtube.com/@StorrorParkourPro]@StorrorParkourPro[/url]).  

There are 2 episodes of a behind the scenes series out to watch, [url=https://youtu.be/io5K_yMhlIw?si=PHsWruV3l4Fi6ayL]episode 1[/url] features our creative director Drew & level architect Sam exploring the council estate which inspired the design of that level, as well as it's rich social history, whilst [url=https://youtu.be/XSncSGNYf4A?si=C98sstiWaNLE-75m]episode 2[/url] features lead programmer David delving into the unique SPP movement & animation system. And there will be more of that to come! So go ahead and follow us over there if you haven’t already, where you can listen and watch our screams into the void on a whole new platform. 

With the game feeling better every day, we’re looking forward to sharing more with you lot within the coming weeks!   

[i]Questions? Got some artwork, or want a discussion? Hit up the community hub and we'll be keeping you updated with what's in store
